svg.title: RoundIA multi-tenant agentic SaaS architecture
svg.desc: Shows how multiple tenants each have isolated agents, LLM routing, MCP tool layer, multi-KB RAG, and observability.
svg.text: Isolated: KBs · agents · keys · usage logs

g.text: State machine · custom-field gate · ReAct tool loop (cap=10) · session summarisation
CRM · ticketing · internal APIs · RBAC per tenant
Working context window · summarised session (–50% tokens) · long-term vector store (per tenant + user)
